names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Θωμάς ο διά Χριστόν σαλός», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 24. април ст. ст., „Преп. Тома Јуродиви.“, with the rank word Преп. and the rank Јуродиви both left off — Јуродиви is the `fool-for-christ` this folder carries in `types`, and BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §5's table reads it as a rank, so it is stripped **although stripping it leaves a bare form that folds**: `thomas-of-constantinople` already holds «Тома». The contract in `src/lib/honorific.js` is that the manifest keeps the bare name, and a fold recorded in the findings table is the sanctioned answer to a shared form, where a rank stored inside a form is a defect the corpus is already carrying in 161 older folders. The heading gives him no city, no monastery and no year besides.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Θωμάς ο διά Χριστόν σαλός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole body of the page is one sentence: «Ο Όσιος Θωμάς, ο διά Χριστόν σαλός, έζησε κατά τον 6ο αιώνα μ.Χ. και κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη» — he lived in the sixth century and fell asleep in peace. **No `dates` were taken**: the bare century is all the page gives and it gives no bounds for it. It names no country, no city, no act of folly, no relic and no hymn, and no couplet. The corpus's four other men named Thomas — the apostle, of Constantinople, of Maleon and of Zographou — are other men on other days.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 07.05.2026 (24. април ст. ст.) — „Преп. Тома Јуродиви.“

death.note: Охридски пролог: „Престави се св. Тома у Дафни код Антиохије, у време патријарха Домина (546-560 г.)“ — the interval is **the entry's own two numbers**, printed in its own parenthesis for that patriarchate, and not a reign this reader dated. The folder carried no dates at all before this reading, and saint.gr gave it none. `node .tmp/dd.mjs "between 546 and 560"` reads «между 546 и 560» and «μεταξύ 546 και 560».
